a.lede: Amazon’s new Fire TV Stick 4K is slimmer and faster, but its biggest upgrade may be the thing you’ll actually hold in your hand: a redesigned remote that’s easier to use, especially in the dark.
a.title: Amazon’s new Fire TV Stick 4K comes with an actually good remote

b.title: Amazon's new Fire TV interface and mobile app will come with Alexa+ upgrades
